summary: The candidate captures nearly all core theorems, lemmas, corollaries, definitions, and external results, with generally faithful mathematical content and explicit attribution. However, it omits the standalone Bauer–Furuta invariant and symplectic-structure definitions and the Betti-parity fact from the gold set, contains duplicated/conflicting entries, and has substantive precision problems: the Lemma 2.6 homology-class expression uses alpha - bar{alpha} instead of the gold alpha times bar{alpha} notation, one Theorem 1.9 variant drops the mod-4 qualification on b2+, and several duplicate statements vary in hypotheses. Page locators also do not consistently align with the verified gold locators.
strengths: All major headline results, including Theorems 1.4, 1.9, 2.3, 2.4, 2.8, and the geometric-simple-connectivity theorem, are represented.

Supporting results such as Taubes nonvanishing, Frøyshov vanishing, Bauer’s connected-sum theorem, the PL-sphere characterization, blow-up formula, and adjunction inequality are extracted with external attribution where applicable.
Most entries preserve the relevant hypotheses, mathematical notation, and entry types, and the candidate provides useful infrastructure beyond the minimum gold set.
issues: The candidate omits gold entries for the Bauer–Furuta invariant definition, the symplectic-structure definition, and the closed symplectic 4-manifold Betti-parity fact.

Lemma 2.6 is represented with the potentially substantive class expression alpha - bar{alpha}, whereas the gold reference uses alpha times bar{alpha}; the duplicated variants also create inconsistency.
Theorem 1.9 is duplicated, and one version states b2+ not equal to 1 rather than b2+ not congruent to 1 modulo 4; the primary version also leaves the modulo qualification syntactically ambiguous.

The candidate contains redundant duplicate entries for reverse orientation, Lemma 2.6, Theorems 2.3 and 2.4, Corollary 2.5, and Lemma 3.1, reducing redundancy control and introducing conflicting formulations.
Several page references, especially for external Taubes and related background results, do not match the verified gold source locators.
